Panama's flagship carrier Copa Airlines signed a $13.5 billion deal Tuesday to purchase 60 Boeing 737 MAX planes, adding to 40 others already on order.The first stage of the expansion aimed to build space for the 40 Boeing 737s Copa already bought that "are being delivered."
